request: Thunderwing Gyronaut: a small gnome flyer (Flying, Ranged: hurls sparks 2 spaces). She wears a backpack with a propeller on its BACK and two mechanical bat wings; these are separate attached props that follow her spine bone, so you only animate her skeleton (the game spins the propeller and the wings are not rigged). REFERENCE VIDEO: the owner had Runway make a short video of each move. Its frames are in the folder refs/ (Read the pictures with the Read tool): refs/gyrocopter-ace--front.jpg, --side.jpg, --back.jpg are her model from 3 sides; refs/gyrocopter-ace-<clip>-<view>/frames/<move>/fNN.jpg are video frames in time order (12 evenly spaced frames per 3 s move, every other frame given, f12 = end). FIRST look at all the pictures for a move, then match her BODY and LIMB poses frame by frame: torso lean and twist, head tilt, arm and leg angles, height above the ground, and the timing (frame N of 12 = N/12 of the clip). This is a rig motion reference only. IGNORE in the video: face and mouth (never animate the face), the propeller jumping onto her head (it stays on the back of the pack), any camera drift, and the moment she spins around in the knocked-back move (she never turns her back). If refs/ is missing or empty, do NOT write any animation files (the job will be retried). Flying overrides the usual 'feet planted' rule: she hovers, her feet never touch the ground; raise her with move on the hips bone (about 12% of her height) and keep that same hover height at frame 0 and the last frame of every clip so they join up. Smooth, even game animation. This job makes OH_Attack and OH_Hit from the video clip 'cast'. Note: the video has no back view for 'fly', but has one for 'cast'. All four Gyronaut clips start and end in the same HOVER pose (hips raised, legs relaxed), not the standing base pose: key the hips (and any bone you change) at frame 0 and the last frame yourself.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Spark throw, from the video clip 'cast', first move 'spark-throw' (refs/gyrocopter-ace-cast-front, -cast-side and -cast-back /frames/spark-throw). From the hover pose: right hand pulls back beside her shoulder while the body coils slightly, then she pushes the right arm straight forward and releases at about frame 36 (mark ctx.event(36,'projectile_release', bone=right hand)), small follow-through, then settles back to the hover pose by the last frame.

animations.name: OH_Hit
animations.description: Knocked back, from the video clip 'cast', second move 'knocked-back' (refs/.../frames/knocked-back). From the hover pose, about frame 10: chest and head jerk backward, arms swing out, she dips down a little in the air, then smoothly recovers to the hover pose. She never turns around.
